hook: Gill Pratt is a roboticist known for his work directing robotics research at DARPA and for leading Toyota's artificial intelligence research effort. He earned his PhD at MIT, later teaching robotics there and at Olin College of Engineering. Before joining Toyota, he served as a program manager at the Defense Advanced Research Projects Agency, where he oversaw robotics programs including the DARPA Robotics Challenge. In 2015, Toyota Motor Corporation created the Toyota Research Institute, based in Los Altos, California, and appointed him to lead it. Under his leadership TRI has conducted research on artificial intelligence, robotics, and automated driving, and he has continued in senior technical leadership roles at Toyota focused on human-centered mobility and automation.
